title: The role of the family
intro: Why the family is the foundation of society, and what makes a Muslim family strong.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah (SWT) says that one of His signs is that He created spouses for you from among yourselves, so that you may find peace with them, and He placed love and mercy between you. Truly, in that are signs for people who reflect. <small>(Qur’an, Ar-Rum 30:21)</small>

When Allah created Hawwa together with Adam (AS), and their children were born, the first family in the dunya came into being. Since then the family has always had the most important place in every time and every society. Scholars have said that the family is the foundation on which the whole of society rests.

Islam sees the family as the basic cell from which the best people grow up. That is why Islam gives special attention to starting and building a family, and gives clear rules for keeping the family healthy.

One of the most important conditions for a healthy family is choosing a spouse. Islam recommends paying attention that the person has faith, and after faith also honesty, gentleness, love, mercy and other good qualities.

It is impossible to imagine a harmonious life without a family, and family life begins with marriage. All religions and all philosophies based on morals agree on this. Marriage is the base on which family life rests.

In Islam, the family in its basic meaning is only the parents and the children. In its wider meaning it also includes the other members: grandfather, grandmother, and after them aunts and uncles and their children. Islam wants to connect as many family members as possible so that the bonds between them are stronger – and that makes the whole society stronger.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: …relatives are closer to one another in the Book of Allah. Truly, Allah knows everything. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Anfal 8:75)</small>

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Allah’s pleasure is in the pleasure of the parents, and Allah’s anger is in the anger of the parents.” (Tirmidhi)

When they marry, a husband and wife must protect their family – this is one of the duties Allah gave them. Like many human values, the family faces challenges that can harm its harmony and even break it apart. Threats can come from outside, but the biggest danger comes from the husband and wife themselves, because of:

items: disagreement between the husband and wife,
not fulfilling the duties of marriage and family.

learn.html: Protecting the family is a duty of each person and of everyone together. Parents and their children each help, in their own way, to keep a healthy family atmosphere full of harmony, understanding and cooperation. Parents do it through love and respect for each other, and children through care and obedience towards their parents.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: A Muslim family is marked by values that always lead to success and a happy family atmosphere.

learn.text: What a Muslim family is like

items.label: Keeping the rules of the faith
Harmony and trust in each other

learn.html: A family that believes in Allah (SWT), does the Islamic duties, keeps away from everything Allah forbade, and where there is trust, sincerity, fairness and kind words, may still have difficulties – but it will solve them much more easily.
